sheets.title: Laurel Parking Expansion Concept Site Plan
sheets.reading_notes: Single-sheet site plan (PDF, 1 page) at scale 0-200 feet. Shows existing building cluster (Bldg 1602, 1604, 1649, 1639, 1601, 1657, 1658, 1659) and three parking areas. Northern existing lot: '38 Spaces Available'. Middle existing lot: '35 Spaces Available' (note states 'Remove 3 spaces for drive aisle' with red X marker at motor pool vans only area). New proposed lot: '40 Spaces', shown in yellow highlight to the south. Scale bar provided. North arrow present. No sheet number formally printed; designated C-1 here as descriptor. No title block with project number visible at this rendering.
